notes.title: Demo Update 1.0 & Achievements! 🎮 🏆
notes.notes:
Hello, we present to you the Housebreaker Demo Update 1.0!

First, we want to thank you for contributing to Steam Next Fest: June 2022! What is your opinion on Housebreaker? Did you like the story presented? Do you have comments or concerns about the game? 

We are waiting for your feedback in the comments section!

We try to provide you with such a product so that you can only benefit from the game and encounter as few errors as possible! Here is a list of the changes and fixes made:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880963/4362e239790c1ba350580c2682a34bafa9182ef2.png

Additionally, Steam Achievements were introduced to the demo version to make the gameplay more enjoyable for players. We also decided on 3 secrets, so if someone has already discovered the secret room, feel free to share your opinion!
